name: GradBlock with Automatic Differentiation
aliases: GradBlock with Automatic Differentiation — AD Tape Surgery, dr.replace_grad
definition: A technique to attach derivative tracking to specific factors within an expression without recomputing the entire primal value, avoiding unnecessary extra computation in both primal and adjoint programs.
summary: GradBlock attaches derivative tracking to specific factors without recomputing primal values, bypassing redundant forward and backward passes to efficiently differentiate detached operations.
